verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA26507225 from Pune Diecast Works to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318739 (dated 2026-09-17). One line: 2,400 pcs of CMP-GAM-010 die-cast statue "The Getaway" at 1037 INR, confirmed for 2026-12-01. Incoterms FOB Nhava Sheva, payment NET30. The supplier states it is approved for serial supply, with PPAP documents submitted 2026-09-14.
red_flags: The approval status is a supplier self-statement on the acknowledgement, not an independent buyer approval.
The unit price has no per-unit basis stated, and the total is not shown.
The document has no issue date.
observations: Typed PDF with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
The document has no issue date; 2026-09-17 is the date of the customer's order.
The quantity unit is not stated.
